name: Shishugounykus
isnote: Qin et al. 2019 described it as a basal alvarezsaurian; Wikipedia revision 1350062700 says its alvarezsaur affinities were later questioned (Agnolín et al. 2021 is among the papers harvested).
sum: Basal alvarezsaurian from the Upper Jurassic Shishugou Formation of Xinjiang, China, whose alvarezsaur affinities have since been questioned.
wsnote: No body size given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted (original description Qin et al. 2019).
material: Not read in the sources consulted.
biology: The Wikipedia article gives no biology; no statement is made here.
author: Qin et al. 2019

sources.text: Zichuan Qin, James Matthew Clark, Jonah N. Choiniere, Xing Xu 2019. A new alvarezsaurian theropod from the Upper Jurassic Shishugou Formation of western China. Scientific Reports. doi:10.1038/s41598-019-48148-7
Federico L. Agnolín, Junchang Lü, Martin Kundrát, Li Xu 2021. Alvarezsaurid osteology: new data on cranial anatomy. Historical Biology. doi:10.1080/08912963.2021.1929203

dates_note: No PBDB record of the genus. The span is that of the Shishugou beds with atlas taxa (formation entry, PBDB ages); the paper title gives Upper Jurassic only.
